messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Latency surge detected: streaming p99 > 3s (SLO 1.0s) across us-west-2. Auto-create thread.

kenna (eng-oncall): saw the bot, I'm on it. linking dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/team/streaming?from=now-1h

maya (eng-sre): p95 780ms -> 1.3s, p99 1.6s -> 4.2s since 11:12 UTC. spike correlates with kernel rollout at 11:08.

choi (eng-runtime): confirmed. recent kube job applied kernel bundle `kernel-2024-11-08-v2` and compilepath flag `ENABLE_COMPILEPATH=1` to inference pools.

ash (eng-platform): rollout notes: TRT8/flashattn build + linker optimizations; feature-flag config pushed to prod at 11:07 via `ffctl apply streaming.compilepath=true`.

maya (eng-sre): logs show streaming decode tail stalls and page fault patterns: snippet:
```
E decode: kv_cache_miss -> pagefault: alloc retry
kernel: comp_path: mmap failed: -12
```

choi (eng-runtime): repro with local perf: enabling compilepath increases p99 on long sequences >1024 tokens by ~2.5x; suspect new kernel allocator path.

kenna (eng-oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) disable feature flag (fast) 2) rollback kernel bundle (slower) 3) route traffic to old pool (safe).

ash (eng-platform): rolling back flag first. running `ffctl rollback streaming.compilepath` now.

deploy-bot: rollback started: ffctl rollback streaming.compilepath -> initiated by ash at 11:23 UTC. targeting pools: inference-prod-usw2*. Progress: 0/8

maya (eng-sre): routing mitigation prepped: if flag rollback doesn't drop p99 under 1.2s in 10m, we'll redirect 40% traffic to legacy-prod pool.

lina (customer-success): notifying top affected customers: AcmeApps, FinPay, EduAI. drafting message now. Estimated degraded requests: 450k tokens in last 30m.

metrics-bot: now: p99 streaming 3.8s -> 2.1s (after rollback started). Monitoring 5m window.

choi (eng-runtime): also seeing kernel pagefault counters decreasing on nodes where flag reversed. patch diff: `compilepath.c` line shows new fallback path that calls `mmap(MAP_POPULATE)`;
```
- ptr = fast_alloc(len);
+ ptr = mmap(.., MAP_POPULATE);
```
Possible regresses on heavy fragmentation.

ash (eng-platform): rollout status: 6/8 pools rolled back, 2 still processing (draining deploys). estimate finish 11:31 UTC.

kenna (eng-oncall): please prepare `kubectl` commands to drain and apply kernel pin if needed. sequence to pin older kernel:
```
kubectl -n inference patch ds inference-gpu -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runner","env":[{"name":"KERNEL_BUNDLE","value":"kernel-2024-10-30"}]}]}}}}'
```

choi (eng-runtime): will hold on patch until we see rollback effect; alerting runtime oncall to stand by @sre_maya

lina (customer-success): CS update sent to AcmeApps + FinPay: short note, working on mitigation, will follow up in 30m. cc: legal.

pm-rob: what's impact for SLAs? any invoices customers need credits? need incident stub for postmortem.

maya (eng-sre): preliminary impact: ~0.3% of requests hit p99 >5s; 12 CRE customers saw errors/stalls; will collect exact numbers and attach to incident page.

deploy-bot: rollback progress: 8/8 pools done at 11:30 UTC. status: complete.

metrics-bot: p99 now 0.95s, p95 0.65s. SLO restored.

kenna (eng-oncall): ok good. next actions: 1) schedule kernel bundle revert PR 2) add canary checks for compilepath allocator 3) update rollout playbook to include fs allocation check.

ash (eng-platform): opening PR to pin kernel and add allocator unit tests. assigning to @choi. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4521

choi (eng-runtime): taking PR. also will add a runtime gauge for pagefault rate into dashboards.

lina (customer-success): will send customer closure note and offer to setup call for affected customers.

pm-rob: assigning postmortem owner -> kenna. ETA draft in 24h.

kenna (eng-oncall): handing off to night oncall @dave_us. summary: rollback of compilepath flag restored SLO; root cause: kernel allocator path in new bundle caused fragmentation + pagefaults under long-seq workloads. see incident page: https://incidents.redwood/1745321987

dave_us: acknowledged, taking watch. if anything regresses ping me. good job team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident resolved (status: mitigated). closing thread.
